description: List sub-plans under a test plan (TP-*); paginated. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions. Requires a test plan identifier (TP-*). Call listTestPlans first if you do not have it. Creating a test plan or sub-plan, and linking or unlinking test runs, are not available as tools here: use the capability functions (they ask you to confirm first).
name: listSubTestPlans
